## 📋 Checklist

**Before submitting:**
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (Biome formatting)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

**Code quality:**
- [ ] Code is formatted with `pnpm format`
- [ ] Linting passes with `pnpm lint:fix`
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes with `pnpm type-check`
- [ ] No console.log statements left in code
- [ ] Error handling is appropriate
- [ ] Greek text is properly encoded and displayed

**Documentation:**
- [ ] README.md updated if needed
- [ ] Code comments added for complex logic
- [ ] API documentation updated if endpoints changed
- [ ] Examples updated if usage changed
